Happy 19th, Francesca - printable card

Prints on one sheet of A4, both sides, then folds in half into an A5 card.

Download PDF See the online card

How to print

  1. Paper: A4, ideally thick card stock (200gsm+). US Letter also works if you choose "Fit to page".
  2. Layout: Landscape, scale 100% / Actual size, margins None.
  3. Turn on Background graphics (Chrome/Edge: "More settings"; Safari: "Print backgrounds").
  4. Double-sided: Flip on short edge. No duplex printer? Print page 1, feed the same sheet back in, then print page 2 on the blank side - try it on scrap paper first, as printers differ in which way round the sheet goes.
  5. Fold in half along the centre (small dashed marks at the top and bottom). The birthday girl goes on the front.
